d:
Mangalsen’s mother-in-law clears it to him that she won’t allow Meenakshi to stay with him for next few days. Mangalsen starts writing love letters for Meenakshi. He is unaware that his family members secretly read his letters before forwarding it to Meenakshi. On the other hand, Meenakshi assumes that her husband has an affair with a woman. Will Mangalsen be able to prove his innocence to Meenakshi?
